_doc: Lane H's classification of every corpus entry that is not Level A/B: the KIND of gap (feature | route | primitive | protocol | remote), the feature requests (docs/design/palw/tir/feature-requests.md) that name it, and one line. 'feature': a generic lowering feature is missing, expressible with the existing primitives; 'route': no data route exists for this kind of model (the lowering is Rust per family or absent), existing primitives suffice; 'primitive': a new general primitive is needed; 'protocol': a capability beyond the IR (an input/output binding, a stage kind) is needed; 'remote': the reference semantics are remote code outside transformers. 'evidence' says what was run: 'adapter' = a third-party adapter was written and the harness shows the single failing step; 'patched' = with the one storage difference removed in a copy of the fixture every stage holds; 'analysis' = read from the transformers code, not yet run.
